provenance.note: INTRODUCED: the PR replaced the select block whose time.After arm let the command exit while the release check was still running with a bare receive, so every extension invocation now waits for the check to finish before PostRun returns; the fix (Fixes #10235) restores a non-blocking select with a default arm
